title: When Hedging Changes the Payoff: Option Replication with Price Impact and Execution Costs
abstract: arXiv:2609.36257v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hedging a derivative by trading the underlying asset changes the payoff that the hedging intended to replicate. We study this phenomenon when trading generates price impact and execution costs. In a binomial model, we characterize replication through a fixed-point equation. In continuous time, we derive a nonlinear pricing PDE whose implicit terminal condition captures the nature of the moving target problem of the hedger. For monotone convex Lipschitz payoffs (such as calls and puts) we establish exact replication under midpoint execution costs. Numerical experiments illustrate: (i) how price impact shifts the effective strike, (ii) the non-linear dependence of the option price on the number of contracts, (iii) how execution costs smooth terminal holdings, (iv) the extent to which the hedger's own trading can bring an otherwise worthless option into the money, and (v) we explain the spread and the shape of the limit order book in the op

translated_title: 当对冲改变收益时：考虑价格冲击与执行成本的期权复制
translated_abstract: 通过交易标的资产对冲衍生品，会改变对冲本来想要复制的收益。我们研究了当交易产生价格冲击与执行成本时的这一现象。在二叉树模型中，我们通过一个不动点方程来刻画复制问题。在连续时间下，我们推导出一个非线性定价偏微分方程，其隐式终端条件捕捉了对冲者所面临的“移动目标”问题的本质。对于单调凸的Lipschitz收益函数（例如看涨期权与看跌期权），我们建立了在中间价执行成本下可实现精确复制的结论。数值实验说明：(i) 价格冲击如何移动有效行权价；(ii) 期权价格对合约数量的非线性依赖关系；(iii) 执行成本如何平滑终端持仓；(iv) 对冲者自身的交易在多大程度上能使一个原本毫无价值的期权变为价内期权；以及 (v) 解释了期权市场中限价订单簿的价差与形状。
tldr: 本文研究了价格冲击和执行成本如何导致期权对冲行为本身改变其想要复制的收益，通过不动点方程和非线性定价PDE刻画了这一“移动目标”问题，并证明在中间价执行成本下单调凸收益（如看涨看跌期权）可实现精确复制。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals how price impact and execution costs cause option hedging itself to alter the payoff it aims to replicate, characterizing this "moving target" problem through a fixed-point equation and a nonlinear pricing PDE, and establishing exact replication for monotone convex payoffs such as calls and puts under midpoint execution costs.
